criteria: Given ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is set, when parallax --prompt-only --record-verdict records an entry, then stdout ends with "(signed)".
Given ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is unset, when parallax --prompt-only --record-verdict records an entry, then stdout ends with "(unsigned)".
intent: Resolve #710: packages/parallax/bin/parallax.mjs prints "gate-manifest: recorded seq=... gate=..." without disclosing whether the entry was signed or unsigned when ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is unset. Append "(signed)" or "(unsigned)" based on typeof entry.sig === "string", matching gate-manifest record.
title: fix(parallax): disclose (signed) or (unsigned) when recording prompt-only verdict to gate-manifest
